name: eu-nordic-open-data-mcp
description: Unified MCP server and 10-tool suite for official European Union and Finnish open data (TED EU tenders, PRH Finnish companies, EU sanctions, VIES VAT, ECB FX & macro, ENISA EUVD CVEs, Fingrid grid signals, FMI weather warnings, FMI-Fingrid nowcast, Digitraffic port calls) with embedded legal attribution and GDPR company-level filtering.
author: Italo Armenti (https://github.com/itulo)
